name: Béret Écarlate - Le Meurtre à l'Orphelinat
source:
Fabienne, a 17-year-old genius, has a rare gift: she detects lies! Until now, her talent has only managed to isolate her from her fellow orphans.

But when she discovers the body of one of her teachers, she’s left with no choice but to uncover the killer among the residents she’s lived with her entire life.

An intense investigation ensues, forcing Fabienne to untangle webs of deceit and uncover the dark secrets of her grim home.

Can she expose the culprit before they kill again?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4528520/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
17岁的天才少女法比安娜拥有一项罕见的天赋：看穿谎言！然而迄今为止，这份才能只让她遭到了孤儿院同伴们的疏远与孤立。

直到她发现了院内一位老师的遗体，别无选择的她只能在这些从小一起长大的孤儿院同伴之中揪出真凶。

一场紧张刺激的调查就此展开，迫使法比安娜抽丝剥茧地解开谎言织就的罗网，揭露这座阴森家园背后黑暗的秘密。

她能否在凶手再次行凶之前将其绳之以法？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4528520/]Steam[/url]]
